correctness.rationale: A direct proof shows a unique totally ramified infinity with pole orders r and r^h+1 upstairs, computes the full diagonal invariant basis under the tame order-2(r-1) group, proves no cancellation of distinct monomial pole orders, and derives every Apéry representative and one-point RR basis. Standard semigroup arguments establish minimality, gaps and genus; exact arithmetic for 14 cases independently checks the computations. Only precisely stated coefficient and characteristic assumptions are used.
